record.tooling: Web + iOS/Android app. No API, no rclone backend. The only path to the unlimited pool is publishing into a public 'branch'.
record.chaining: Unlimited public bytes x N accounts, but 20 MB per file. A 20 TiB corpus would be 1,000,000 objects, which is a metadata problem before it is a storage problem.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 20 MB on the unlimited public tier; anything over 20 MB draws down the 10 GB private quota instead.
record.reliability_note: Front page returned HTTP 504 gateway timeout during testing. Archived help documentation specifies a 20 MB file limit footnote.
